parsed.note: Raising MATRIX_LR from 0.08 to 0.1 is a legitimate hyperparameter change that leaves the fixed evaluation (EVAL_SPLIT='val', EVAL_SHARD=10, EVAL_TOKENS) and the train/eval shard separation (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9') untouched, so val_bpb still measures real model quality.
